'''Puzzle boxes''' can be obtained by doing hard, elite, and master [[Treasure Trails]]. Before you are able to continue with your clue scroll, you will have to complete the puzzle.

A puzzle box is always scrambled 101 times before being handed to the player, by randomly sliding a piece into the empty position starting from the solved state.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1301202083845201921|date=2 September 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109428|archivedate=11 April 2023|quote=[Any clue if puzzle boxes have the same amount of scrambles every time, thanks ash!] Yes, and it's 101 for standard treasure trails, 255 for the Monkey Madness reinitialisation puzzle.}}

If you have a duplicate puzzle box, (obtained by a method such as the [[Drop trick]]) in your inventory or bank after completing the clue, you cannot obtain another clue.
